description: Read-only Git metadata inspection, not verified policy or execution readiness. Ancestry uses a local remote-tracking snapshot, not fresh remote state. Branch roles, ticket and commit-prefix conventions remain unresolved; remote BU synchronization is unknown. Top-level verified covers status metadata only; refs.verified is independent. Separate from inspect_mcdev_project auth protection checks. No policy persistence, branch changes, commit-message/history/auth/artifact-content reads or native mcdev/live execution. Prevent concurrent project/Git mutation; not an atomic snapshot.
name: inspect_mcdev_git_policy
